qc.label_under_test: the possessive pronoun after 'hold' in body idioms (hold your breath, hold my hand, holding her tongue); possessives after other verbs (lose, wash, find) stay low

neighbours.label: the possessive pronoun after 'hold' in body idioms (hold your breath, hold my hand, holding her tongue); possessives after other verbs (lose, wash, find) stay low
fire: We all held our breath as the results came in.
She held her mother's hand during the film.
You should hold your tongue at the meeting.
I wouldn't hold my breath waiting for that train.
Just hold your nose and drink it.
He was holding his breath under the water.
They held their hands up and walked out.
Hold your horses, we're not done.
quiet: We all lost our keys as the results came in.
She washed her mother's hair during the film.
You should mind your manners at the meeting.
I wouldn't spend my money waiting for that train.
Just blow your nose and drink it.
He was catching his fish under the water.
They raised their hands and walked out.
Feed your horses, we're not done.

notes: Fresh idioms with 'hold'; near misses keep the possessive after other verbs. The card also has ' take' (take sides, 0.27 in a probe), which the label does not cover.
